## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The *Wǔshì Pípóshā Lùn* 五事毘婆沙論 (Skt. *Pañcavastu-vibhāṣā*, CBETA T28n1555) is a Tang dynasty translation of a Sarvāstivāda Abhidharma treatise in 2 juan, attributed to the Venerable Dharmatrāta 尊者法救 ([法救](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B3%95%E6%95%91)) and translated by Xuánzàng 玄奘 ([玄奘](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%8E%84%E5%A5%98)). The text is a commentary on "five topics" (*wǔ shì* 五事) of Abhidharma doctrine, specifically five categories particularly debated within the Sarvāstivāda tradition: form (*rūpa*), feeling (*vedanā*), consciousness (*vijñāna*), and related categories.

**Abstract**

The *Pañcavastu-vibhāṣā* is a brief but focused commentary attributed to Dharmatrāta 法救, one of the four major Kaśmīra Vaibhāṣika masters frequently cited in the *Mahāvibhāṣā* ([KR6l0010](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6l/KR6l0010)). It treats five specific Abhidharma topics in vibhāṣā (exposition/commentary) style, providing definitions, analyses, and sub-distinctions. As a short specialist text, it complements the broader *Zá āpítán xīn lùn* ([KR6l0017](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6l/KR6l0017)) also attributed to the same master.
